content: Member-only story The Bizarre 2025 Cyberattack That Turned a Printer Into a Weapon Noel 4 min read · Just now -- Share How a Forgotten Printer Exploit Nearly Destroyed a Small Business — and What You Can Learn From It When a Quiet Print Shop Became Ground Zero for a Cyber Nightmare No One Saw Coming “We thought it was a joke… until the printer started printing ransom notes.” 🕵️ The Attack No One Predicted: Printers, Popups, and Pandemonium In June 2025, a small but thriving design and print shop in Ohio became the victim of one of the strangest cybersecurity attacks ever recorded . What started as a routine Tuesday morning turned into a digital horror story: their networked printers began spitting out sheets of ASCII skulls, riddled with threats and cryptocurrency wallet addresses. At first, the team thought it was an internal prank. It wasn’t. 🚨 Enter: The “FantomPrint” Exploit — The Real Monster in the Machine A new strain of malware, dubbed “FantomPrint” , had entered the scene.
